property_summary: For any address p that is not a re-entrant contract, after p withdraws its full balance once, p's balance is zero and cannot be withdrawn again unless p adds more Ether; the buggy version leaves the stale balance after the external call, so a re-entrant caller can drain the contract's pre-existing funds.
change_summary: Delete the state update that zeros the caller's balance before the external call.
